clauses.why: Zadok carried the ark back together with Abiathar, and the command is in verse 25.
clauses.english: carried the ark of God back to Jerusalem with Abiathar at David's command
clauses.ukr: повернув із Евіятаром Божого ковчега до Єрусалиму за наказом царя
clauses.deu: brachte mit Abjathar die Lade Gottes auf Befehl des Königs wieder gen Jerusalem
clauses.spa: volvió con Abiathar el arca de Dios a Jerusalem por mandato del rey

clauses.why: Zadok anointed Solomon in verse 39; verse 38 only says they brought him to Gihon, and the place is better stated with it, but the clause is accurate; citation should include both for Gihon.

clauses.english: was put by the king in the place of Abiathar as priest
clauses.ukr: був настановлений царем священиком замість Евіятара
clauses.deu: wurde vom König an die Statt Abjathars als Priester gesetzt
clauses.spa: fue puesto por el rey como sacerdote en lugar de Abiathar
